{{nihongo|'''Igasa Shrine'''|伊笠神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Awa Province (Tokushima)]].

'''Igasa Shrine''' (いがさじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} located in {{ill|Tokushima Prefecture|Q160734|qid=Q160734}}{{ill|Awa, Tokushima|Q791587|qid=Q791587}}{{ill|Ichiba-chō Inuhaka|Q55523676|qid=Q55523676}}. It is one of the candidate shrines (ronsha) for {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}・{{ill|Takefutsu Shrine|Q48758365|qid=Q48758365}}.

=== History ===
It is enshrined on the summit of {{ill|Mount Igasa|Q60997765|qid=Q60997765}}, the highest peak of the former {{ill|Ichiba, Tokushima|Q5986083|qid=Q5986083|lt=Ichiba Town}}.

Founded in {{ill|1655|Q6975|qid=Q6975}} ({{ill|Jōō (Edo period)|Q1145081|qid=Q1145081}} 3rd year, {{ill|September 13 (Lunisolar)|Q840131|qid=Q840131|lt=September 13}}). It was later restored in {{ill|1729|Q6952|qid=Q6952}} ({{ill|Kyōhō|de|Kyōhō|es|Kyōhō|fa|کیوهو|fr|Ère Kyōhō|ja|享保|ko|교호|ru|Кёхо|simple|Kyōhō|sr|Кјохо|sv|Kyōhō|tr|Kyōhō|zh|享保|qid=Q1145048}} 14th year). One theory says that it enshrines a branch of the {{ill|Nitta clan|Q2274150|qid=Q2274150}}.

The enshrined deity, Ame no Futakami no Mikoto, is considered another name for {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|Q91088537|qid=Q91088537|lt=Ame no Murakumo no Mikoto}}, but according to the “Heisei Festival Data” published by {{ill|Association of Shinto Shrines|Q908077|qid=Q908077}}, it is enshrined only at Igasa Shrine.

=== Enshrined deity ===
* {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|Q91088537|qid=Q91088537|lt=Ame no Futakami no Mikoto}}

=== Access ===
* From the {{ill|Tokushima Expressway|Q11490216|qid=Q11490216}} “{{ill|Donari interchange|Q10927770|qid=Q10927770}},” via {{ill|Japan National Route 318|Q6157220|qid=Q6157220}} and {{ill|Tokushima Prefectural Road Route 139|Q11490019|qid=Q11490019}}.
